notes: All contract values are LTA "estimated total fee" over the firm 5-year term in nominal dollars at award; LTA footnotes state they exclude indexation for inflation, wages and fuel, service variation and incentive payments. None of the releases uses the phrase "at today's prices".

Annex A bid prices are defined as one-off pre-operation costs + total service fee + lease charges for LTA-provided assets (2017-2020 annex notes); i.e. they are gross of the lease charges payable to LTA.

In several tenders the winning bid was not the lowest price (Bukit Merah 2018 lowest: Jiaoyun/GSH; Bulim+SY 2020 lowest: SBST; Seletar 2024 lowest: TTS Alt 2; Tampines 2025 lowest: SBST Base). Two-envelope quality-first evaluation.

NOT FOUND from official sources: (a) LTA original release for Loyang award (23 Nov 2015) and the 11 Aug 2016 negotiated-contract release with its Annex B package details (old LTA URLs redirect; Wayback Machine returned HTTP 429 to automated requests) - secondary reproductions used and flagged; (b) number of buses per package for 2017-2026 awards (not stated in releases, except Bulim ~320 and Sembawang-Yishun ~400 in 2020 Annex B image); (c) annual public bus-km operated for 2015-2025 (data.gov.sg/SingStat publish rail train-km but no bus-km after 2014); (d) MOF Budget "Head W" MOT expenditure PDFs (51-mot-YYYY.pdf) returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-13, so Committee of Supply bus-contracting lines were not captured; (e) contract values of post-2021 negotiated extensions (MOT: commercially sensitive).
LTA FY = 1 April to 31 March; "financial year ended 31 March 2026" = FY2025/26. LTA fare revenue in the Bus Contracting fund is bus only; Rail Contracting (TEL/JRL) is reported separately.
PTC "fare revenue increase" figures cover bus + all rail; the "bus and TEL collected by LTA" figure mixes bus with TEL rail.
Small inconsistency: LRT ridership 2015 is 152 (LTA PDF) vs 153 (SingStat table). Bus series match exactly.
Secondary sources (Land Transport Guru, The Independent) are flagged with "secondary": true; use only where no official text was retrievable.
Text in image-only PDF pages (2020 Annex B) was read visually and cannot be machine-verified; marked local_file null.
